action.objective: Verify c3e4 with the reserved budget to obtain commit-ready status, checking the d4-d3 push and queen pressure on f2.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search ranked c3e4 top (579, exact) with PV Nc3e4 Qf4 f2f3. It is the reserved candidate with 2000 nodes for single-candidate verification. The Black d4 pawn attacks neither knight, and Ne4 challenges the f6 queen and controls d6/c5, while keeping the b7 knight safe. Black may push d4-d3 or play Qf4 hitting f2; verification must check whether early queen activity refutes Ne4, since c3-b1 and c3-a4 were only upper bounds and unverified.
